title: Quiz 1 — Physics in Real Life & Motion
revision: 2026-11 rev2 — 70:30 LOTS:HOTS, balanced choices, in-scope items only

questions.text: A rice cooker switches from COOK to WARM by itself once the water is used up. Which area of daily life does this physics application MOST directly improve?
options: Household tasks
Health and safety
Work productivity
Leisure and recreation
questions.correct: Household tasks

questions.text: Which statement BEST describes translational motion?
options: Every part of the object moves the same distance in the same direction
The object turns around an axis that stays in one place
Points far from the center move faster than points near it
The object moves back and forth around one resting position
questions.correct: Every part of the object moves the same distance in the same direction

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of PURELY rotational motion?
options: A ceiling fan blade spinning in place
A ball rolling across the classroom floor
A jeepney moving along a straight road
A child sliding down a straight slide
questions.correct: A ceiling fan blade spinning in place

questions.text: Which quantity is measured in radians per second (rad/s)?
options: Angular velocity
Linear velocity
Angular displacement
Angular acceleration
questions.correct: Angular velocity

questions.text: In the equation v = r × ω, what does r stand for?
options: Distance of the point from the axis
Number of turns made per minute
Time needed for one full turn
Angle swept by the object in radians
questions.correct: Distance of the point from the axis

questions.text: A wheel of radius 0.5 m turns at an angular velocity of 4 rad/s. What is the linear speed of a point on its rim?
Ana sits near the edge of a turning merry-go-round while Ben sits near the center. Which statement about the two of them is TRUE?
options: Same angular velocity, but Ana has the greater linear speed
Same linear speed, but Ben has the greater angular velocity
Ana has both the greater angular velocity and linear speed
Ben has the greater linear speed because he is near the axis
questions.correct: Same angular velocity, but Ana has the greater linear speed

questions.text: Which branch of science studies matter, energy, motion and force, and how they interact?
options: Physics
Chemistry
Biology
Geology
questions.correct: Physics

questions.text: A bowling ball rolls down the lane without slipping. Which description of its motion is MOST accurate?
options: It translates and rotates at the same time
It only translates, since its center moves forward
It only rotates, since each point circles the center
It slides forward while it does not spin at all
questions.correct: It translates and rotates at the same time

questions.text: Which statement does NOT describe physics improving daily life?
options: Adding heavy weight to a bicycle makes braking easier
Seatbelts stop the body more gradually during a crash
Eyeglass lenses bend light so images focus clearly
Water pumps use pressure to lift water to upper floors
questions.correct: Adding heavy weight to a bicycle makes braking easier

questions.text: A store owner must load heavy sacks of rice onto a truck. Which choice uses physics to make the job need LESS force?
options: Push the sacks up a long, gently sloped ramp
Lift each sack straight up as fast as possible
Carry two sacks at a time to finish sooner
Drag the sacks across the rough cement floor
questions.correct: Push the sacks up a long, gently sloped ramp

questions.text: Angular displacement is usually measured in which unit?
options: Radians
Meters
Meters per second
Newtons
questions.correct: Radians

questions.text: What is the angular displacement of an object after ONE complete rotation?
options: 2π radians
π radians
π/2 radians
4π radians
questions.correct: 2π radians

questions.text: Which pair correctly matches a linear quantity with its angular counterpart?
options: Velocity (m/s) ↔ angular velocity (rad/s)
Displacement (m) ↔ angular velocity (rad/s)
Acceleration (m/s²) ↔ angular displacement (rad)
Velocity (m/s) ↔ angular acceleration (rad/s²)
questions.correct: Velocity (m/s) ↔ angular velocity (rad/s)

questions.text: A bicycle wheel of radius 0.3 m spins at 6 rad/s. What is the linear speed of the tire's edge?
options: 20 m/s

questions.text: A barangay wants fewer injuries among tricycle passengers when the driver brakes suddenly. Which measure is MOST effective, based on physics?
options: Install seatbelts that hold passengers in their seats
Paint the tricycle in brighter, easy-to-see colors
Use a louder horn so other drivers hear it sooner
Put softer foam on the floor of the passenger sidecar
questions.correct: Install seatbelts that hold passengers in their seats

questions.text: What does the equation d = r × θ relate?
options: Arc length to the angle turned (in radians)
Speed to the time of one full rotation
Force to the length of the lever arm
Mass to the radius of the turning body
questions.correct: Arc length to the angle turned (in radians)

questions.text: A phone's GPS finds your location by timing signals sent from satellites. What carries these signals?
options: Radio waves
Sound waves
Ultrasound pulses
Infrared heat
questions.correct: Radio waves

questions.text: Passengers lurch forward when a jeepney suddenly brakes. Which explanation is correct?
options: Their bodies keep moving forward because of inertia
The brakes push the passengers forward with a force
Air rushes in from behind and pushes them forward
Gravity pulls them toward the front of the jeepney
questions.correct: Their bodies keep moving forward because of inertia

questions.text: A bike shop says: "At the same wheel angular velocity, a bike with bigger wheels moves faster." Which judgment is BEST supported by v = r × ω?
options: True: a larger radius gives a greater linear speed
False: wheel size never affects a bicycle's speed
False: bigger wheels always have smaller angular velocity
True: bigger wheels are heavier, so they gain momentum
questions.correct: True: a larger radius gives a greater linear speed
